'''SIS Group Enterprise'''<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://businessworld.in/article/COVID-Is-A-Watershed-Moment-For-Security-Facility-Management-Sector/30-04-2020-190751|title=COVID Is A Watershed Moment For Security, Facility Management Sector|first=Abhay|last=Shukla|website=BW Businessworld}}</ref> (formerly '''Security and Intelligence Services (India)''') is a private security firm in India, Australia, New Zealand and Singapore. It was set up in 1985 by [[Ravindra Kishore Sinha]] who is an Indian billionaire businessman and journalist.<ref name="b">{{Cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/profile/ravindra-kishore-sinha/?sh=420d492b240a|title = SIS Founder - Ravindra Kishore Sinha| website=[[Forbes]] }}</ref> which is now led by his son Rituraj Sinha as Group Managing Director.<ref name="moneycontrol.com"/> SIS Group is one of the largest manpower security firms in the Indo-Pacific region with sales in excess of [[₹]]15,982 [[crore]] (FY2026).<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/overseas-business-helps-security-firm-sis-india/article32590181.ece|title = Overseas business helps security firm SIS India|newspaper = The Hindu|date = 12 September 2020|last1 = Mishra|first1 = Lalatendu}}</ref> The company offers Security, Cash Logistics, and [[Facility management|Facility Management]] Services in India, Australia, and a few Asia-Pacific regions.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/sis-37791/information/company-history|title = SIS LTD. (SIS) - COMPANY HISTORY}}</ref> Currently, [[Ravindra Kishore Sinha]] is the Chairman and Rituraj Kishore Sinha is the group managing director of the SIS Ltd.<ref name="w">{{Cite web|url=https://sisindia.com/our-company/leadership/board-of-directors/|title = SIS India - Board of Directors}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/17895424|title = Rituraj Sinha - Managing Director SIS India| website=[[Bloomberg News]] }}</ref>

==History==

===Origins===
SIS Group Enterprise, formerly known as Security and Intelligence Services (SIS India), was set up in [[Patna]], [[Bihar]], in 1978 by RK Sinha.<ref name="b"/> The inception of the company by RK Sinha occurred after his career as a Trainee reporter ended in 1973. He set up the Security and Intelligence Services India Ltd. company in a small Garage in Patna with Rs 250 at 23 years old.<ref name="c">{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/entrepreneurship/from-rs-250-to-rs-2700-crore-r-k-sinhas-sis-is-the-first-indian-mnc-in-security-industry/articleshow/27718323.cms|title = From Rs 250 to Rs 2,700 crore, R K Sinha's SIS is the first Indian MNC in security industry| newspaper=The Economic Times | date=23 December 2013 | last1=Shanbaug | first1=Amit }}</ref>

===1985–1990===

In its foundation year, 1986, SIS India launched its Graduate Trainee Officer (GTO) program initiated to build a cadre of security officers and managers. The company also employed a workforce between 250-300 people with a turnover of ₹1 [[Lakh]].<ref name="c"/>

In 1989, SIS India developed a DOS-based software program for payroll & its management on 486 computers.<ref name="d">{{Cite web|url=https://sisindia.com/our-company/sis-through-the-ages/|title = SIS Through The Ages}}</ref>

===1991–2006===

In 1991, SIS India completed the milestone of crossing its employee count beyond 1000.<ref name="d"/>

In 1998, SIS India obtained ISO Certification, becoming the first Indian Security company to acquire it.<ref name="d"/>

In 2002, Rituraj Kishore Sinha, an alumnus of [[University of Leeds|Leeds University]] Business School, joined his family business, SIS. As part of a larger professional management team, the initial focus was on business process reengineering and geographical expansion of SIS which was an INR 25 crore company at that point but a very well regarded brand in the industry.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/changing-lanes/how-rituraj-sinha-is-changing-the-security-company-his-father-founded/32674/1|title = How Rituraj Sinha Is Changing The Security Company His Father Founded}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/indias-largest-security-firm-sis-unique-growth-plan-is-out-of-the-box-4726681.html|title = India's largest security firm SIS' unique growth plan is out-of-the-box}}</ref>

In 2004, SIS India developed and launched the first integrated end-to-end ERP platform<ref name="d"/>

===2006–2021===

In 2007, SIS India commenced its West India operations by the inauguration of its regional office in Mumbai. In the same year, The company also received approximately ₹50 crores investment from DE Shaw, Hedge Funds Firm.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/indias-family-businesses/how-siss-multipronged-expansion-approach-brought-it-international-success/46415/1|title = How SIS's multi-pronged expansion approach brought it international success}}</ref>

In 2008, SIS acquired Australia's largest security company, [[Chubb Security]], becoming the first Indian multinational in security services.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/sis-open-to-buys-in-security-biz/articleshow/46913065.cms|title = SIS open to buys in security biz}}</ref> The acquisition of the Australian guarding and mobile patrol business unit of US industrial conglomerate United Technologies was handled by Citigroup on their behalf.

In 2010, SIS India launched its Electronic Security arm under the name of TECH SIS.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/company/tech-sis-limited/U75300BR2010PLC015484|title = Tech SIS Limited}}</ref>

In 2011, SIS India formed a joint venture with Prosegur called SIS Prosegur for providing SIS Cash Services.<ref name="e"/>

On 24 August 2011, SIS announced that it is entering into a joint venture with [[Terminix]], to perform pest and termite control in India.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/sis-terminix-forms-joint-venture-for-pest-control-services/article23058241.ece|title = SIS, Terminix forms joint venture for pest control services}}</ref> The venture incorporated Pest Control Segment into its Facilities Management Segment and is called TerminiXSIS.

In 2013, SIS India received ₹550 crores investment from CX Partners, a [[private equity firm]], affirming history's largest PE investment in the Security Sector. In 2014, SIS India celebrated its 40th anniversary, with its consolidated revenue crossing Rs 2500 crore. The company also acquires the ISS cash business and rebrands it as SISCO.<ref name="e"/>

In 2016, SIS India made over Rs 4000 crore in revenue, besides acquiring Dusters, becoming India's 4th largest Facility Management Provider.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/sis-india-buys-stake-in-dusters-total-solutions/article9008445.ece|title = SIS India buys stake in Dusters Total Solutions}}</ref>

In 2017, the SIS Group IPO was launched, making the company the first in the nation to become listed.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/sis-ipo-to-hit-street-on-july-31-key-things-to-know/things-you-need-to-know-about-sis-ipo/slideshow/59788259.cms|title = SIS IPO to hit Street on July 31: Key things to know}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.livemint.com/Money/IyZVMJuT5muyk3ifDXYQNK/SIS-IPO-to-eb-launched-on-Monday-firm-seeks-to-raise-up-to.html|title = SIS IPO to be launched on Monday, firm seeks to raise up to Rs780 crore}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/sis-india-sets-ipo-band-at-rs-805-815/article64270293.ece|title = SIS India sets IPO band at Rs 805-815}}</ref>

In 2018, SIS India consolidated its leadership position in India Security & FM by acquiring stakes in SLV,<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.punekarnews.in/sis-acquire-slv-security-services/|title = SIS acquire SLV Security Services}}</ref> Bengaluru-based Uniq Detective and Security Services & Rare Hospitality and Services Pvt. Ltd.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/sis-acquires-controlling-stake-in-bangalore-based-uniq-118121701072_1.html|title = SIS acquires controlling stake in Bangalore-based Uniq}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/sis-india-acquires-80-stake-in-rare-hospitality-118101700360_1.html|title = SIS India acquires 80% stake in Rare Hospitality}}</ref>

In 2019, SIS India crossed a workforce of more than 200,000 with over $1 Billion in revenues. The company also consolidated APAC leadership in Security by acquiring Henderson& Platform 4 Group.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.dealstreetasia.com/stories/sis-india-singapore-henderson-119118/|title = SIS India eyes SEA foray, to quire 60% stake in Singapore's Henderson}}</ref>

In 2021, SIS Group’s Q3FY22 was a record quarter for the company with its highest ever revenue at Rs. 2,601 crore said Rituraj Sinha.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/security-and-intelligence-services-profit-rises-to-rs-101-crore-in-q3-122020301643_1.html/|title = Security and Intelligence Services profit rises to Rs 101 crore in Q3}}</ref> SIS India was felicitated as one of the Best Mega Employers in India. Also, It has been recognized as a “Great Place to work” by the GPTW Institute India. Mr. Rituraj Sinha credited his employees for the achievement and said they would strive to achieve further heights.<ref name="aw">{{Cite news|url=https://www.securitytoday.in/indian-news/sis-group-certified-as-great-place-to-work-by-gptw-institute|title = SIS Group certified as "Great Place to Work" by GPTW Institute}}</ref>

===Since 2022===

In 2022, SIS crossed Rs 10,000 crore annual revenue mark for the first time. SIS has reported consolidated revenue for FY22 at Rs 10,059 crore.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/sis-crosses-rs-10000-crore-annual-revenue-mark-for-the-first-time/2513099/|title = SIS crosses Rs 10,000 crore annual revenue mark for the first time}}</ref>

In FY22, SIS entered into the Rs10,000-crore revenue club by clocking Rs10,059.1 crore, a growth of over 10.2 percent over the last fiscal. The security services, facility management and cash logistics major took just five years to double its revenue. Rituraj Sinha, however, uses a long-term lens to make sense of the data. “From Rs25 crore in 2002 to Rs10,000 crore in 2022. That’s our story,” he says. He quickly qualifies his statement. “It’s a profitable and sustainable story,” <ref name="forbesindia.com">{{Cite news|url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/take-one-big-story-of-the-day/mcdonalds-down-under-and-bharat-army-how-sis-doubled-its-revenue-to-rs-10000-crore-in-five-years/76449/1|title = McDonald's, down under and Bharat army: How SIS doubled its revenue to Rs 10,000 crore in five years}}</ref>

Addressing to the press and the investors Group Managing Director of Group SIS Mr. Rituraj Sinha expressed confidence that the group would continue to grow to greater heights and become an industry leader in the fields of security services, facility management and cash logistics and suitably rewards its employees and investors alike. <ref name="businessworld.in">{{Cite news|url=https://bwpeople.businessworld.in/article/SIS-Ltd-Commits-To-Creating-10-000-Additional-Jobs/30-08-2022-444516/|title = SIS Ltd Commits To Creating 10,000 Additional Jobs}}</ref>

==Operations==

===Activities/Services===

The company offers security services to banks, hotels, institutions, IT & ITES, residential colonies, Retail and commercial establishments. It also offers electronic security systems, consulting, housekeeping and security services like Pre-employment Verification & Surveillance, Cash services which include the transfer of cash and valuables and ATM replenishment and recruitment and training services.<ref name="a"/>

===India & Overseas===

The company has over 22,000 customers which include major industry players such as [[Tata Steel]], [[Tata Motors]], [[ICICI Bank]], [[Idea Cellular]] and [[Future Group]].
<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.bhaskarenglish.in/originals/news/mega-empire-sis-security-company-started-operations-from-2-rooms-134280390.html|title=MEGA EMPIRE-SIS security company started operations}}</ref>

Over the last decade, company has diversified its domestic play and opted for an aggressive inorganic route to expand overseas.<ref name="forbesindia.com"/>

===Operating Structure===

SIS Group Enterprise Segments its business structure into three key areas:

* Security Services which includes services for security design, [[fire safety]], event security, VIP protection, aviation security, emergency response, investigation work, and integrated man-tech.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/security-services-firm-sis-looks-to-recover-to-pre-covid-levels/article35850419.ece|title = Security services firm SIS looks to recover to pre-Covid levels}}</ref>
* Cash Logistics Services which are offered under SIS Prosegur, in partnership with Spain’s Prosegur - Security Company, to provide cash-in-transit, doorstep banking, ATM-related services, Precious Cargo, bullion management, and cash vaulting services.<ref name="e">{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/sis-prosegur-acquires-cash-management-business-of-iss/articleshow/42067983.cms?from=mdr|title = SIS Prosegur acquires cash management business of ISS}}</ref>
* Facility Management Services which includes Soft Facility Management and Hard Facility Management Operations & Management.

===Covid Vaccinations===

SIS Group, has completed inoculating 102,008 employees of its 2,30,000 workforce. This was done through Humare Heroes Vaccination Drive (HHVD) launched on May 1, 2021, within a record timeframe of 30 days. “While we put a lot of effort in arranging the vaccines for our employees, the availability and feasibility helped our team to turn this into a reality,” said Rituraj Sinha, managing group director, SIS Ltd.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/sis-completes-100k-vaccinations-for-employees-across-india-in-record-time-121053101473_1.html|title = SIS completes 100k vaccinations for employees across India in record time}}</ref>
